design.note: Every arm present in the earlier target observing run reproduces bit-exactly on these seeds; the added arms extend the run rather than replace it.

success_criteria.expanded: a trace counts as successful when the holder was EXPANDED. This is the criterion of the original TARGETBAND arm and is strictly stronger than discovery, because a peer in the final breadth level is reached but never expanded.
success_criteria.reached: a trace counts as successful when the holder was REACHED, which is the criterion a search uses.
